_meta.description: Per-genre reference values for the MixCoach rule engine. Rules in rule-bindings.json read these by dotted path (e.g. genre_profiles.modern_trance.loudness.club.lufs_target). Tune these numbers without touching engine code.
_meta.source: Genre reference research report (90s/classic trance, modern trance, techno).

provenance_legend.standard: Formal standard or published platform target — authoritative.
provenance_legend.rule_of_thumb: Widely-repeated production/mastering convention, not a formal standard.
provenance_legend.interpolation: Derived/estimated where sources gave ranges or no direct measurement. Weakest confidence — verify against a measured corpus before treating as hard thresholds.

all_values_units.plr: dB (max true peak minus integrated LUFS)

_platform_targets._note: Cross-genre streaming normalization facts. Rules read the streaming master target from here; the per-genre club target lives in each profile. provenance: standard.
_platform_targets._hot_master_rule: If integrated louder than hot_master_threshold_lufs, hold true peak at hot_master_true_peak_dbtp to avoid lossy-codec distortion (Spotify guidance). provenance: standard.

classic_trance._note: The most dynamic of the three. Tie this profile to original-era pressings, not loud reissues.

club._note: Original 90s masters predate LUFS metering; estimated from DR10–11 crest data. Weakest loudness figure in the file.

stability._note: short_term_max minus integrated LUFS - EBU R128 programme-dynamics spread (LRA family). Classic trance's real breakdown/full-section contrast swings wider, so a higher floor; cutoff pending corpus validation.

crest_db._note: Measured DR10–11 from Dynamic Range DB (PvD 'For an Angel' DR10, AvB '76' DR11).

lra_lu._note: Higher than modern due to genuine breakdown↔full-section contrast.

transient_strength._note: avg_transient_strength = mean librosa onset_strength; level/normalization-dependent, NOT a calibrated absolute. Placeholder floor pending a measured corpus; rule ships suspected=true.

spectral_tilt._note: Bright/airy supersaws and high-end sheen; kick de-emphasized relative to bassline. Less bright than modern trance, brighter than techno.

stereo._note: Wide detuned supersaw fields; keep kick/bass/lead centered.

bpm._note: Uplifting signature ~138 BPM. Progressive/melodic strand runs slower; treat as a sub-window.

club._note: Festival-oriented masters push to the loud end. iZotope top-dance analysis median ~-8.3 LUFS ±1.

stability._note: short_term_max minus integrated LUFS - EBU R128 programme-dynamics spread (LRA family). Festival masters with big breakdowns swing moderately; cutoff pending corpus validation.

lra_lu._note: Big breakdown raises LRA above straight techno.

transient_strength._note: avg_transient_strength = mean librosa onset_strength; level/normalization-dependent, NOT a calibrated absolute. Placeholder floor pending a measured corpus; rule ships suspected=true.

spectral_tilt._note: Brightest of the three — detuned supersaw stacks, leads 1–3.5 kHz, high-shelf air on the sides.

stereo._note: Armada tutorial uses 120 Hz kick/bass mono crossover. Supersaws must survive mono.

techno._note: Loudest and most static of the three. Dynamics figures are the weakest-sourced in the file — see _meta provenance and verify against measurement.

bpm._note: Sources disagree on peak-time center (126–132 vs 132–135); treat 128–135 as the window.

club._note: Samplesound techno-mastering guide: -8 to -6 LUFS typical; some tracks reach -5 or louder.

stability._note: short_term_max minus integrated LUFS - EBU R128 programme-dynamics spread (LRA family). Techno is static/constant-loudness, so a wide spread is more anomalous; a lower floor flags instability sooner. Cutoff pending corpus.

crest_db._note: WEAKEST FIGURE: DR rows for named peak-time artists could not be retrieved; inferred from LUFS/LRA + DR-DB note that dense electronic is normal at DR5.

lra_lu._note: Constant-beat material sits ~4 LU regardless of compression; LRA<3 may be inherent, not over-limiting.

transient_strength._note: avg_transient_strength = mean librosa onset_strength; level/normalization-dependent, NOT a calibrated absolute. Placeholder floor pending a measured corpus; rule ships suspected=true. Techno's dense kick-forward material may tolerate a lower floor.

spectral_tilt._note: Mid-forward, driving; kick often loudest element; less top-end air than trance.

stereo._note: Tight, mono-robust groove; percussion panned but core kept centered.

arrangement._note: No euphoric melodic breakdown/drop; evolves by layering and micro-variation.

_tuning_notes.build_a_corpus: Replace interpolation-tagged crest/LRA/tilt numbers with measured medians + p10/p90 from 20–30 pro tracks per genre run through a BS.1770 + DR meter.
weakest_figures: all dynamics.transient_strength (placeholder; avg onset strength is not a calibrated absolute)
_tuning_notes.platform_drift: If Spotify moves off -14 or a new club-delivery standard emerges, update _platform_targets and each profile's loudness.club.
